title: Cross-validate: sign in A, verify in B/C
notes: 2026-08-25 cross-interop blocker: Python/PyNaCl and Rust verify every fixed link_frame_signed_modes.json signature and reject component/signature mutations. Existing C primitive schnorr48_verify also verified all 6 canonical preimage/signature pairs in a ctypes run, proving core Schnorr interoperability. But C schnorr48_verify_frame rejected all 6 (generic=True, frame=0 each). Root cause in lichen/subsys/lichen/link/schnorr48.c:282-380 and 385-475: signer_iid/signer_iid_len are [[maybe_unused]], frame hashing starts at LENGTH with header||payload, omitting mandatory LICHEN-LINK-v1\0 domain and 8-byte signer EUI-64. Header contract claims signer coverage at include/lichen/schnorr48.h:129-131 but implementation contradicts it. The only C cross-language frame oracle is disabled at lichen/tests/schnorr48/main.c:502-607/633-634. Standalone existing C suite passes because it tests the same stale self-consistent helper. Current phase forbids C production edits, so cannot close until C frame transcript is corrected and the fixed-vector C consumer is enabled for all address modes/tamper cases.
